learningObjectives.text: Describe the arrangement and movement of particles in solids, liquids and gases
Explain melting, boiling, condensing and freezing as changes of state
Use the particle model to predict what happens when a substance is heated or cooled

photographable.why: The method is the particle model, which is a diagram, not a photograph.

brief.adds: Hooks the topic with one everyday question pupils can already argue about.

brief.adds: Defines the three states of matter and names an everyday example of each.
brief.avoids: Do not repeat the vocabulary definitions.

brief.adds: Walks through one change of state step by step with the particle model.
